system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Medicine and Stealth, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Battlefield Medicine Lore, Wound Care Lore, Military Logistics Lore.
system.description: You treated injuries close enough to danger that keeping out of sight was part of keeping someone alive. You learned to work quickly and leave a place before the fighting reached it.
